## Circular to all Licensed Corporations

## Implementation of prudent risk management policies and procedures

In view of possibly high volatile market condition in the next year, we would like to share our view on the significance of prudent risk management system. Particularly, when the firm also trades  in  complex  financial  instruments  and  over-the-counter  derivative  products,  it  is important  to  establish  and  maintain  effective  risk  management  systems  and  procedures  to cover the following specific areas:

- Conduct  due  diligence of counterparties to understand their financial status and competence in trading the products;
- Avoid  building  up  excessive  or  concentrated  exposures  to  particular  counterparties, products or markets;
- Mitigate uncovered market or credit exposures by consistently and timely implementing established risk management measures such as margining requirements etc.; and
- Monitor and control risk exposures to acceptable and appropriate levels.

The Commission will continue to work together with the industry to promote effective and efficient risk management practices.
